title: Case 036: Door Without an Address
initial_request: The door at one of my houses is damaged, but I have two properties and haven’t said which one. Can you help me report it?
overview: Henry Walsh first reported a damaged door without identifying which of his two homes was affected. Mia asked him to identify the property and say whether the entrance needed urgent protection; Henry then provided the address, 136 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 9ZZ, and confirmed that the entrance was temporarily secured. Mia recorded the message as a notification on the correct property policy and confirmed this to Henry.

next_action.summary: At the escalation point, ask Henry which property is affected and whether the entrance needs urgent protection before linking the message to a policy.

outcome: Henry’s message was processed in the correct case as a notification; no insurance claim outcome or cover decision is stated.

events.body: A door at one of my houses has been damaged. I own two properties, so I’m not sure which policy you should put this under yet.

Could you confirm which property the damaged door is at before I link your message to a policy? Please also let me know whether the entrance needs urgent protection; if it is unsafe, keep clear and arrange appropriate help rather than attempting repairs yourself.
It is the property at 136 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 9ZZ. The entrance has been temporarily secured, so it does not need further urgent protection at present.

events.to: Property policy record for 136 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 9ZZ
events.body: Henry identified this as the affected property and confirmed the entrance is temporarily secured. I have linked his door-damage message to the correct property policy as a notification, not recorded it as a claim submission.

Thanks for confirming the address. I’ve recorded your message about the damaged door against the correct property policy as a notification; this confirms the message was processed, not a decision on cover or a claim outcome.
